question: Sorry to bring up the Sasageru IF again, but Lumera is such a sweet girl, I love her so much. It's unavoidable that it takes nearly 400 years for Ia to become Lumera, but will the day ever come when Ia speaks to Julius in that manner?
answer:
Whether that happens in the main story depends on whether Julius can elevate them another step.

The speech styles and visual settings for the other girls are prepared in my head, but whether there will be an opportunity to showcase them... In that case, Subaru would have to sleep for another 400 years.
